query: INSERT INTO observations_quarantine (entity_id,source_id,document,reason) SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::text[],$2::text[],$3::jsonb[],$4::text[]) ON CONFLICT (entity_id,source_id,(document->>'metric'),(document->>'period'),(document->>'observed_at')) DO UPDATE SET document=EXCLUDED.document,reason=EXCLUDED.reason,held_at=now()
